d: India pulled off a stunning one-wicket win over Pakistan in the U19 Asia Cup final, recovering from 252/8 to chase down 338 on the final ball. But Shoaib Akhtar has a rather different take on the result. The former Pakistan pacer believes his team were the 'far superior' side, despite failing to close out the final. So, what exactly does superiority mean when the opposition walks away with the trophy? Rupha Ramani looks at Akhtar's comments, Pakistan's familiar struggles against India and the controversy surrounding the celebrations.
